caveat: Historical results and candidate counts were known before this protocol. Same dataset, same node split, no independent new holdout. Gate copied from historical code; cannot establish pre-outcome freezing or strict promotion. Transductive graph and morphology use all nodes; bilateral pairs are not grouped, so pair leakage remains possible. Full-label nomination is descriptive, not held-out validation or confirmed misannotation. Initialization is now seeded before model construction, unlike historical runner. No tuning or retry based on the rerun outcome.
gate: PASS iff GCN mean test accuracy > CNN mean + population SD AND > linear mean + population SD, and >=1 full-label descriptive candidate with p_annotated<0.2 and margin>0.5. No minimum count tied to the historical 97. No strict promotion.
split_rule: class-stratified node split; sorted classes; NumPy default_rng(11); train first floor(0.6*n_class), minimum 1; rest test
